clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995-1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within about a year and a half, you said your mother Lena grew worn out with the baby, your father Paul took to working late and distant from Lena, you had stomach aches and missed school, Paul and your brother Jonah fell into shouting matches, and Lena did not go back to her job; the long quiet afterward, until the move to the city in 2003, reads as the family settling.
